confirm.title: Close Orchester while agents are working?
confirm.description: Closing stops the runner and every agent in it. Orchester has no background mode, so nothing keeps running after the window closes.

waiting.title: Saving before closing
waiting.description: No new steps or tool calls will start. Each agent is finishing its current work up to the next checkpoint. Orchester closes when every run is saved and paused.

saved.title: All runs saved · closing Orchester
saved.description: Every run is paused at its checkpoint. Resume them as usual next time; nothing else is needed.

lastEvent.seconds: Step still running · last event {{seconds}} s ago
lastEvent.minutes: Step still running · last event {{minutes}} min ago

waitingNote.plan: {{task}} waits for your plan decision. No agent works on it, so closing doesn't change it.
waitingNote.answer: {{task}} waits for your answer. No agent works on it, so closing doesn't change it.
waitingNote.decision: {{task}} waits for your decision. No agent works on it, so closing doesn't change it.
waitingNote.several: {{tasks}} wait for you. No agent works on them, so closing doesn't change them.

choice.waitDetail: No new steps or tool calls start. Each agent continues to its next checkpoint, the runs are marked paused, then Orchester closes. This can take a few minutes. Resume the runs as usual next time.
choice.quitDetail: Stops the runner and agents immediately. Work after each run's last checkpoint is not recorded as progress. Uncommitted changes stay in the worktree and are shown on next start.

close.tooLong: Taking too long? Quit now stops the remaining agents. Their runs keep the last checkpoint they already saved; work after it is not recorded as progress.
close.cancelUnavailable: Cancel is unavailable: the runners already stopped starting new work.

title.one: {{count}} run was interrupted when Orchester closed
title.other: {{count}} runs were interrupted when Orchester closed

summary.one: Its worktree and commits are kept. Continue it from its last checkpoint, or leave it stopped.
summary.other: Their worktrees and commits are kept. Continue them from their last checkpoint, or leave them stopped.

crashed.one: Orchester stopped unexpectedly. Nothing has been restarted. Continue the run from its last checkpoint, or leave it; work after a checkpoint is not counted as done.
crashed.other: Orchester stopped unexpectedly. Nothing has been restarted. Continue all of them from their last checkpoints, or none; work after a checkpoint is not counted as done.

quitNow.one: You chose Quit now. Nothing has been restarted. Continue the run from its last checkpoint, or leave it; work after a checkpoint is not counted as done.
quitNow.other: You chose Quit now. Nothing has been restarted. Continue all of them from their last checkpoints, or none; work after a checkpoint is not counted as done.

reason.runnerFailed: The runner could not record the run

recovery.note: Uncommitted changes are kept in each run's worktree and are never discarded silently. If you don't continue now, you can continue each run later from its task page.

partial.title: {{continued}} of {{count}} runs continued
partial.one: {{task}} could not continue. {{reason}} It stays interrupted; continue it later from its task page.
partial.other: {{tasks}} could not continue. Each stays interrupted; continue it later from its task page.

unread.title: The runs Orchester's last session interrupted could not be read
unread.body: {{reason}} Each stays interrupted; continue it later from its task page.
